canonical_title: Instinct raises $1 billion for personal AI agent at $10 billion valuation
treatment: Repeat only for material product availability, adoption, transaction capability, safety architecture, or financing changes.
known_facts: Instinct raised $1 billion and said its valuation reached $10 billion.
Its personal agent handles tasks including travel planning, grocery purchases, ticket booking and subscription cancellation.
A concierge offering can call businesses on users' behalf; the company also described isolated sandboxes, short-lived local credentials and active hallucination detection.
reinclude_only_if: New autonomous transaction or tool capability
Material safety or privacy architecture change
notes: Selected for agentic-AI adoption/capital signal rather than funding alone.
